name: Java@CV Cobra
description:
Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

  • Taught by experienced programmers

    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: Build an Online Portfolio
description:

In this engaging workshop for students in grades 7-12 with some programming experience, we’ll guide them through building an online portfolio to showcase their coding projects and accomplishments. It’s a fantastic way to build confidence, share their passion, and take pride in their achievements—all while learning valuable real-world skills. Join us for a hands-on experience that celebrates creativity and innovation!

This camp is for kids grades 7-12 with some programming experience.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: Winter SLAM - 3 Day
description:

Accelerated Learning During Thanksgiving and Winter Break

What Is It?

A special 3-day intensive program for Java and Python students to advance their coding skills during the holiday season!

Perfect For:

  • Students currently in Levels 0-6
  • Those wanting to jump ahead in their learning
  • Students who'll miss regular classes due to holiday travel

  • Expert teacher supervision

name: Game Making with MakeCode
description:
Give your child the thrill of making their very first video game! Kids in grades 3 through 12 will work alongside a live instructor to design a main character, add movement, and create simple challenges--then watch their game come to life. It’s a fun, beginner-friendly way to spark creativity, build problem-solving skills, and get them excited about technology.

For programmers from 3rd to 12th grade.

name: Build an Online Portfolio
description:
Help your young programmer shine! In this engaging workshop for students in grades 7-12 with some programming experience, we’ll guide them through building an online portfolio to showcase their coding projects and accomplishments. Having a portfolio at a young age can give them a head start when applying to colleges, internships, or even future jobs in tech. It’s a fantastic way to build confidence, share their passion, and take pride in their achievements—all while learning valuable real-world skills. Join us for a hands-on experience that celebrates creativity and innovation!

This camp is for kids grades 7-12 with some programming experience.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

Learn how to use python, one of the hottest programming languages used today. Python is used in everything from machine learning to data science. Our online Python Classes are for kids & teens who are eager to learn programming. We work closely with all students to make coding fun and engaging. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.


  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 4-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: AI Agents@CV
description:
AI Agents: License to Code

Weekly Ongoing Class – Grades 5–12


 Build games, apps, and awesome projects with the help of AI!

In this fun, hands-on class, you’ll team up with AI coding agents to bring your ideas to life. You’ll create projects—like interactive games and web apps—while learning real coding skills along the way.

How it Works:

  • Start Anytime: Jump in at any point

  • Learn by Doing: Tell the AI what you want to build, guide it as it writes code, and learn how to make it your own.

  • Keep Leveling Up: Projects get more exciting and skills keep growing each week.

It’s like having a pro coder as your sidekick—so you can focus on creativity, problem-solving, and having fun while learning real-world coding skills.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: Build an Online Portfolio
description:
Help your young programmer shine! In this engaging workshop for students in grades 7-12 with some programming experience, we’ll guide them through building an online portfolio to showcase their coding projects and accomplishments. Having a portfolio at a young age can give them a head start when applying to colleges, internships, or even future jobs in tech. It’s a fantastic way to build confidence, share their passion, and take pride in their achievements—all while learning valuable real-world skills. Join us for a hands-on experience that celebrates creativity and innovation!

This camp is for kids grades 7-12 with some programming experience.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: AI Agents@CV
description:
AI Agents: License to Code

Weekly Ongoing Class – Grades 5–12


 Build games, apps, and awesome projects with the help of AI!

In this fun, hands-on class, you’ll team up with AI coding agents to bring your ideas to life. You’ll create projects—like interactive games and web apps—while learning real coding skills along the way.

How it Works:

  • Start Anytime: Jump in at any point

  • Learn by Doing: Tell the AI what you want to build, guide it as it writes code, and learn how to make it your own.

  • Keep Leveling Up: Projects get more exciting and skills keep growing each week.

It’s like having a pro coder as your sidekick—so you can focus on creativity, problem-solving, and having fun while learning real-world coding skills.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: Winter SLAM - 3 Day
description:
Holiday Coding SLAM!

Accelerated Learning During Thanksgiving and Winter Break

What Is It?

A special 3-day intensive program for Java and Python students to advance their coding skills during the holiday season!

Perfect For:

  • Students currently in Levels 0-6
  • Those wanting to jump ahead in their learning
  • Students who'll miss regular classes due to holiday travel
  • Anyone wanting to keep their coding skills sharp over break

Program Features:

  • Guided learning environment
  • Expert teacher supervision
  • Personalized progress tracking
  • Flexible holiday scheduling

Details:

  • Price: $235 (includes all 3 sessions)
  • Format: In-person instruction
  • Prerequisite: Must be enrolled in regular weekly classes (Levels 0-6)

name: Game Making with MakeCode
description:
Give your child the thrill of making their very first video game! Kids in grades 3 through 12 will work alongside a live instructor to design a main character, add movement, and create simple challenges--then watch their game come to life. It’s a fun, beginner-friendly way to spark creativity, build problem-solving skills, and get them excited about technology.

For programmers from 3rd to 12th grade.

name: Build an Online Portfolio
description:
Help your young programmer shine! In this engaging workshop for students in grades 7-12 with some programming experience, we’ll guide them through building an online portfolio to showcase their coding projects and accomplishments. Having a portfolio at a young age can give them a head start when applying to colleges, internships, or even future jobs in tech. It’s a fantastic way to build confidence, share their passion, and take pride in their achievements—all while learning valuable real-world skills. Join us for a hands-on experience that celebrates creativity and innovation!

This camp is for kids grades 7-12 with some programming experience.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

Learn to program in Java, one of the most important languages for commercial software development, and the language used in AP Computer Science. Many students explore our extensive curriculum and stay with our program through 12th grade.

  • Classes meet one day per week for 1.5 hours
  • Tuition is $280/month
  • Student–teacher ratio of 5:1
  • Taught by experienced programmers
  • Grades 5-12 only

    • Our weekly classes run every week throughout the year, so when you register, we will enroll you at the same class time every week (bulk enrollment). You can then cancel or reschedule individual classes online through the client portal.


    To register for weekly classes

    • Review the schedule below for a day and time slot. ( It's best to select the "Month" view. )
    • Create a client account , and add your students to the account
    • Enroll in a first class for the day and time you want, from the list of classes below.
    • To enroll in all classes of the same day and time, every week, you can:
      • Email Liz Groves at info@jointheleague.org ( Click to compose an email ) with the day and time you would like.
      • Call us at (858) 284-0481.
      • Your child's instructor can enroll your child at the beginning of class.
    For all details on enrollment, please see our Enrollment Guide and our Policies and Procedures.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

In this engaging workshop for students in grades 7-12 with some programming experience, we’ll guide them through building an online portfolio to showcase their coding projects and accomplishments. Having a portfolio at a young age can give them a head start when applying to colleges, internships, or even future jobs in tech. It’s a fantastic way to build confidence, share their passion, and take pride in their achievements—all while learning valuable real-world skills. Join us for a hands-on experience that celebrates creativity and innovation!

This camp is for kids grades 7-12 with some programming experience.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.

name: AI Agents: License to Code
description:
This camp is tailored to kids and teens grades 5 through 12

Learn to build interactive games and web applications by collaborating with AI coding agents. This hands-on course teaches you to direct, understand, and refine AI-generated code while creating real projects you can share and use.

A New Way to Code
Instead of memorizing syntax or struggling through documentation, you'll learn to partner with Claude Code and other AI agents to bring your ideas to life. Describe what you want, guide the AI, understand what it creates, and refine the results into polished projects. It's like having a senior developer pair programming with you from day one.

name: Robot Riot@CV
description:
Build & Code: Micro:Bit Robotics

Take your coding skills to the next level by building and programming your own robot! In this exciting hands-on camp, students will use the Micro:Bit microcontroller to bring their creations to life. You'll learn how to program sensors, motors, and LEDs using Python, JavaScript, or block-based coding. Work with friends to design, build, and code robots that can move, interact, and respond to their environment. This camp is perfect for young engineers and programmers who want to explore the world of robotics in a fun and interactive way!

All equipment will be provided by The League of AMAZING Programmers. If you would like to keep your robot at the end of the course there will be an additional fee of $55.00 for the starter kit. As we progress through the course there may be optional add ons to the robot that can be purchased through amazon, those are optional and will be communicated if/when your child gets to that point.
